name: faq
description: Frequently-asked-questions section: a heading, an optional description, a stack of native <details data-ui='collapsible'> questions and a closing contact line. Composition only: zero JavaScript, no controller, no reactive directives — the two layouts are pure CSS grid and the optional numbering is a CSS counter.

heading.description: Section heading. Give it an id and point the section's aria-labelledby at it so the landmark is named. A direct child in the stacked layout; inside intro in the split layout

description.description: Optional intro paragraph under the heading. A direct child in the stacked layout; inside intro in the split layout

intro.description: Wrapper for heading, description and footer — required by the split layout, where it sticks beside the questions from the lg floor; omitted by the stacked one

items.description: The stack of questions. Put one nested <details data-ui='collapsible'> per question directly inside; its <summary data-part='trigger'> and <div data-part='content'> are the COLLAPSIBLE's parts, not the faq's. Only the gap between questions is drawn here (--faq-gap)

footer.description: Closing line under the questions — typically 'Still have questions?' with a nested data-ui='link'. A direct child in the stacked layout; inside intro in the split layout

numbered.description: Prefix every question with a two-digit counter. The number is drawn by the collapsible root's ::before and read from a CSS counter on items, so the markup does not change and nothing has to be renumbered when a question moves.

--faq-gap.description: Space between questions (custom property, set on the root or on items). Pass a spacing token.

required_attrs: aria-labelledby on the section pointing at the heading id
every question is a <details data-ui='collapsible'> whose trigger is its <summary>
descriptive link text in the footer (never 'click here')
a11y.notes: The questions are native disclosure widgets: the browser manages the expanded state and the summary's implicit aria-expanded, so the section needs no ARIA wiring of its own. The counter drawn by data-numbered is generated content and is not announced consistently; it is a visual aid, so never make the number the only way to refer to a question.

keyboard.Tab: move through the question summaries and any footer link in source order
keyboard.Enter/Space: toggle the focused question open or closed (native <summary> behaviour)

templates.html:
{heading}

{description}

{question}
{answer}

{footer_text} {footer_label}

notes: The questions are nested collapsibles, so each one keeps the collapsible's five-attribute contract: its root carries data-variant (bordered, as here, or default) and its summary and body are the collapsible's trigger and content parts. A nested root must not also carry a faq data-part — put it inside [data-part='items'] instead.

The faq never styles a collapsible's parts. The stack is spaced through [data-part='items'] (--faq-gap), and data-numbered hangs its counter off the collapsible ROOT — the items part's direct child — with a padding gutter, so the summary's own padding, hover fill and chevron are untouched.

The split layout needs [data-part='intro'] around heading, description and footer so the three can stick as one block; the stacked layout leaves them as direct children of the section. The stylesheet reaches every intro part both ways.
